scope.summary: Implement the `effect` command family over StudioEffectStack/StudioAdjustment/StudioLiveFilter/StudioBlendMode: apply/update/reorder/toggle/mask-edit/remove/bake as reversible steps; brush/graphic-style application. Consumes foundation RasterEngine (MT-017); deduped from brush/effect/adjustment source domains into ONE family. Dry-run/receipt/undo/promotion; emits STUDIO_EFFECT_APPLIED/STUDIO_ADJUSTMENT_APPLIED; GPU-required effects declare dependency.
acceptance_criteria: effect family on one contract over RasterEngine; reversible steps; GPU-declare; dry-run/promotion
proof_targets: effect family runtime test + stack-restore undo
expected_tests: live: effect.apply dry-run + promote + undo restores exact prior stack
test: EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE surfaced headless when GPU-required

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No effect/adjustment automation on the unified contract.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
